{{Quote|When you see Jolluc, take him. If you don’t see him, hold fire, shut your eyes, and leave the convoy to look out for itself. No heroics.|Niner to Omega Squad|<ref name="o66" />}}
'''Jolluc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Maujasi]] leader that led the Mauja clans in raiding [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] supplies en route to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="o66" />

[[Omega Squad]], a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit, was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] him. During a particular raid on a Republic convoy, Jolluc led the assault and he was [[Death/Legends|shot]] in the head by [[Corr Skirata|Corr]]. [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] shot him again as a precaution.<ref name="o66" />

He was described as a balding man in his fifties. He wore several pieces of [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|trooper armor]] which he presumably took from dead [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="o66" />
